history.finding_analysis: in every past case found (Kristin and Leonardo, 2026; Lisbon floods, 2022; Martinho, 2025; Elsa, 2019; Leslie, 2018), the government's declaration came after the storm hit, and closures were decided locally on the morning; for CHARLES the government closed schools a day ahead. 'A first' is the historian's claim to re-check, not a fact.
